gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-sarpanch: Fast and pushy: Ethnocentric spreads big bowls well apart. Sarpanch is the approachable half, a sans-serif whose lowercase e opens clearly and whose ascenders sit close to the x-height.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-savate: Aggressive, that's Ethnocentric: wide, fast and smooth across big bowls. Savate then settles into paragraphs smoothly, its gently modulated strokes holding steady and its tall rounded o nearly matching the capital O.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-schibsted-gro: Approachable Schibsted Grotesk meets fast, aggressive Ethnocentric. Ethnocentric is built to shout with wide-set letters and big bowls, while Schibsted Grotesk does the quiet work with tall-bowled e and a that never close in.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-sintony: Sintony reads chunky and tall through the middle of each line, smooth with no clogged curves, while Ethnocentric stretches out. Fast and aggressive, the heading is the loud one.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-sulphur-point: Sulphur Point draws its lines like a steady marker, bulky and open. Ethnocentric does speed and swagger best, its wide spacing and big bowls pushing forward, while the body keeps its gaps open.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-vend-sans: Vend Sans draws a ruler-straight, constant-width line with wide unclosed terminals and an x-height that fills the line. Paragraphs move smoothly beneath Ethnocentric, which stays fast and aggressive up top.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-yaldevi: Fast, wide-set and a bit aggressive, Ethnocentric leads with big bowls and short ascenders. Yaldevi takes the other job, carrying outsized lowercase with an e whose eye opens clearly to the right.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-amiko: Galaxy keeps its line width uninterrupted on every letter. Amiko brings lowercase strokes as tall as a crayon mark, with outward-pointing terminals, a sturdy modern partner for the loose, cosmic letters.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Galaxy holds a compass-pencil consistency in every stroke. Anek Gurmukhi comes in with big counters in every small letter, leaving the dense cosmic lettering above it some room to breathe.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-anek-kannada: Cosmic and commanding, Galaxy spaces its letters loosely. Anek Kannada does the grounded work instead, with terminals that stop well away from the stem and a high x-height.
